aciklama: UNITED KINGDOM — EVERY ITEM OF THIS PACK THAT IS TAKEN FROM NICE GUIDANCE. FOR THE LAWYER. By the owner's order of 2026-10-10 ("Bring on the NICE tables. We will do a lawyer review later.") numbers and category names of NICE guidance may stand in this pack as country data, each credited to NICE, with its meaning unchanged, and never NICE's prose. NICE's own terms, as the tools audit read them (docs/araclar-denetim/GB.md, "Licence terms, as read"): commercial reuse inside the United Kingdom is allowed under its UK Open Content Licence with conditions; use for AI purposes needs NICE's written permission; use outside the United Kingdom needs NICE's agreement. Each entry: the file and the line where the item stands (the line carries the mark NICE-KAYNAKLI: and the guidance number), the guidance, the address opened, the date, and exactly what was taken. A test (countries/gb/gb-araclar.test.ts) holds this list to the marks in the folder: an item without an entry, or an entry without its mark on that line, fails. NOT TAKEN, although the order allows it, and why: the PSA referral levels by age (NG12), the HbA1c and haemoglobin limits (NG28, NG203), the albuminuria categories and the referral list (NG203), the PASI treatment criteria (CG153) and the blood pressure thresholds (NG136) — no switched-on tool of this pack has a place for them (see the pull request's report).
